title: MingCute Screenshot Quality Recovery batch 063
review_goal: Differentiate github, globe, and grok variants with screenshot grounded depicts and deterministic evidence fields.

items.depicts_observation: Cat head silhouette with two ears above two narrow lower tail lines
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants the standalone cat silhouette without any outer ring around it.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the circled github mark when the cat should sit inside a border.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows the cat face and tail lines alone with no enclosing circle.

items.depicts_observation: Cat head silhouette centered inside one circular border ring
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants the cat silhouette enclosed inside a full circular border.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the plain github silhouette when no outer ring should appear.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot wraps the same cat silhouette inside a clean circle frame.

items.depicts_observation: Desk globe ring on a stand with one right arc around a centered circle
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a classroom desk globe sitting on a small stand base.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the world globe grid when latitude and longitude lines should cross inside the sphere.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows a globe on a stand with one sweeping right arc and no inner map grid.

items.depicts_observation: World globe ring with one vertical curve and two crossing latitude arcs inside
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a world globe with inner latitude and longitude curves.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the desk globe when the lower stand and side support arc should remain visible.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot fills the globe with crossing inner curves and removes the desk stand.

items.depicts_observation: Square outline frame with one diagonal slash line rising inside
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a square frame containing a simple diagonal slash line.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the circular grok mark when the outer shape should curve into a ring.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot is built from a square border with a single slash line across the inside.
